about_the_game:
A Fallen Knight's Journey

As a fallen knight, you awaken in a dark and mysterious world. Your once-mighty steed has been torn from the skies by an unknown force, leaving you stranded and alone. To survive, you must forge weapons and armor, gather food, and build a secure refuge. But beware—dark forces lurk in the shadows, and not all creatures in this world are friendly.

FORGE, FIGHT, AND SURVIVE

Arm yourself with powerful weapons and hardened armor to withstand the dangers of this grim world. Master the art of forging to upgrade your gear and prepare for ever-deadlier foes. Battle with sword, axe, or bow against hostile warriors and eerie creatures that roam the land.

BUILD YOUR STRONGHOLD

Construct your own fortress and fortify it against enemy assaults. Choose strategic locations for your refuge - perched on towering cliffs, hidden within dense forests, or buried deep underground. Build forges, supply caches, and secret chambers to safeguard your resources.

FACE POWERFUL FOES AND DARK FORCES

Menacing creatures and cursed warriors patrol the ruins of a fallen realm. Venture into ancient ruins to uncover hidden secrets and valuable artifacts. But beware - deep within the darkness, horrors await, eager to consume your soul.

EXPLORE A WORLD OF MYSTERIES

Wander through a world shrouded in secrets and lost truths. Why are you here? What led to your downfall? Unravel the mysteries of this forsaken land, discover hidden writings, and piece together its dark past.

Prepare for a grim and epic adventure where only the strongest will survive. Will you fulfill your destiny, or will you be lost to the shadows?

short_description: A brand-new fantasy multiplayer survival crafting game where you explore a vast and perilous world, tame mysterious creatures, and command them to fight, build, and farm. Gather resources, construct fortresses, and forge powerful weapons as you uncover ancient secrets and battle formidable foes.
